events.title: Abraham's Call
events.description: God calls Abram to leave Ur and go to the land that God will show him. He is promised that he will become a great nation.

events.title: Abram in Egypt
events.description: Due to famine, Abram goes to Egypt where he presents Sarai as his sister.

events.title: Abram and Lot Separate
events.description: Abram and Lot separate because of conflict between their herdsmen. Lot chooses the Jordan Valley, and Abram remains in Canaan.

events.title: Abram Rescues Lot
events.description: Abram defeats the kings who had taken Lot captive and meets Melchizedek, king of Salem.

events.title: The Covenant with Abraham
events.description: God makes a covenant with Abraham and promises him the land of Canaan and countless descendants.

events.title: Hagar and Ishmael
events.description: Sarai gives her maidservant Hagar to Abram. Hagar bears Ishmael, the ancestor of the Arabs.

events.title: Circumcision is instituted
events.description: God gives Abraham circumcision as a sign of the covenant. Abram becomes Abraham and Sarai becomes Sarah.

events.title: The Three Visitors
events.description: Three men (angels) visit Abraham by the oaks of Mamre and promise that Sarah will bear a son.

events.title: Abraham intercedes for Sodom
events.description: Abraham bargains with God to spare Sodom if there are righteous people there.

events.title: Sodom and Gomorrah
events.description: God destroys the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah because of their sin. Lot and his daughters are saved.

events.title: Lot's Daughters
events.description: Lot's daughters have children with their father. They become the matriarchs of the Moabites and Ammonites.

events.title: Abraham at Abimelech
events.description: Abraham lives in Gerar and presents Sarah as his sister. Abimelech takes her, but God warns him in a dream.

events.title: The Birth of Isaac
events.description: Abraham and Sarah have their son Isaac in old age, fulfilling God's promise.

events.title: Hagar and Ishmael Are Sent Away
events.description: Sarah demands that Hagar and Ishmael be sent away. God promises to make Ishmael into a great nation.

events.title: The Sacrifice of Isaac
events.description: God tests Abraham by asking him to sacrifice Isaac. At the last moment, God intervenes and provides a ram as a substitute offering.

events.title: The Death of Sarah
events.description: Sarah dies at the age of 127. Abraham buys the cave of Machpelah as a burial place.

events.title: Rebekah Is Brought as Wife for Isaac
events.description: Abraham's servant finds Rebekah at the well and brings her to Isaac.

events.title: The Death of Abraham
events.description: Abraham dies at the age of 175 and is buried in the Cave of Machpelah next to Sarah.

events.title: Jacob and Esau Born
events.description: Isaac and Rebekah have twins, Esau and Jacob. Jacob buys the birthright from Esau.

events.title: Isaac with Abimelech
events.description: Isaac lives in Gerar during a famine. He passes off Rebekah as his sister, and God blesses him greatly.

events.title: Isaac's Blessing
events.description: Jacob tricks Isaac into giving him Esau's blessing by disguising himself. Esau swears revenge.

events.title: Jacob's Dream
events.description: Jacob dreams of a ladder reaching to heaven at Bethel and receives God's promise of blessing.

events.title: Jacob with Laban
events.description: Jacob serves Laban for 14 years to get Rachel and Leah as wives, and is tricked into marrying Leah first.

events.title: Jacob's twelve sons
events.description: Jacob has twelve sons with Leah, Rachel, Bilhah, and Zilpah. They become the ancestors of Israel's twelve tribes.

events.title: Jacob breaks with God
events.description: Jacob wrestles with a man (angel) through the night and receives the name Israel.

events.title: Jacob and Esau are reconciled
events.description: After 20 years, Jacob and Esau meet again. Esau forgives his brother.

events.title: Dinah and Shechem
events.description: Shechem rapes Dinah. Simeon and Levi avenge their sister by killing all the men in Shechem.

events.title: Rachel's death
events.description: Rachel dies in childbirth when she gives birth to Benjamin. She is buried by the road to Ephrath.

events.title: The death of Isaac
events.description: Isaac dies at the age of 180. Esau and Jacob bury him together in the cave of Machpelah.

events.title: Esau's descendants
events.description: Esau settles in the hill country of Seir and becomes the ancestor of the Edomites. His descendants become chiefs and kings.

events.title: Joseph's dreams
events.description: Joseph dreams that his brothers' sheaves bow down to his, and that the sun, moon, and stars bow down to him.

events.title: Joseph sold as a slave
events.description: Joseph's brothers sell him to Midianite merchants. He is taken to Egypt.

events.title: Judah and Tamar
events.description: Tamar disguises herself as a prostitute to bear children with her father-in-law Judah. She gives birth to Perez and Zerah.

events.title: Joseph in Potiphar's House
events.description: Joseph serves in Potiphar's house but is thrown into prison after a false accusation from Potiphar's wife.

events.title: Joseph Interprets Dreams in Prison
events.description: Joseph interprets the dreams of Pharaoh's cupbearer and baker while in prison.

events.title: Joseph Interprets Pharaoh's Dreams
events.description: Joseph interprets Pharaoh's dreams about seven fat years and seven lean years, and is appointed to govern Egypt.

events.title: The Brothers Come to Egypt
events.description: Joseph's brothers come to Egypt to buy grain during the famine. Joseph recognizes them.

events.title: Joseph Reveals Himself
events.description: Joseph reveals his identity to his brothers and forgives them. He sends word for his father.

events.title: Jacob Moves to Egypt
events.description: Jacob and his entire family move to Egypt due to the famine and settle in Goshen.

events.title: Jacob Blesses His Sons
events.description: Jacob blesses his twelve sons with prophetic words about each tribe's future.

events.title: The Death of Jacob
events.description: Jacob dies in Egypt at the age of 147 and is buried in the Cave of Machpelah in Canaan.

events.title: The Death of Joseph
events.description: Joseph dies at the age of 110. He makes the Israelites promise to carry his bones with them when they leave Egypt.
